showhowGuide.connectBody: Recording and editing stay on this Mac. Connect OpenRouter when you want a guide.
showhowGuide.ownKey: Use your own OpenRouter API key.
showhowGuide.saveError: Couldn’t save the connection. Try again.
showhowGuide.removeError: Couldn’t remove the key. Try again.
showhowGuide.runError: Couldn’t make the guide. Your recording is safe.
showhowGuide.previewError: Couldn’t prepare the guide. Check the recording folder and try again.
showhowGuide.turnInto: Turn this recording into a guide
showhowGuide.localBody: Showhow transcribes on this Mac. OpenRouter uses the transcript and selected frames to write the guide after you continue.
showhowGuide.keepUsing: You can keep using Showhow while this runs.
showhowGuide.safe: Your recording and deterministic steps are safe.
showhowGuide.narrationOnly: No clicks were captured, so steps follow what you said. Screenshots come from the recording at each transcript timestamp.
showhowGuide.clickOnly: Your guide uses clicks and screenshots. Your recording is saved.
showhowGuide.noInputTitle: Nothing to turn into a guide
showhowGuide.noInputBody: This recording has no clicks or speech. Record again with the microphone on, or narrate while you click.
showhowGuide.noInputSend: This recording has no clicks or speech, so there is nothing to send.
showhowGuide.remakeReplacesEdits: Remake replaces your edited steps with a new guide.

showhowLibrary.noMatch: No titles match “{{query}}”. Try another search.
showhowLibrary.pickBody: Choose one from the library, or record something new.

importVideo.title: Import video
importVideo.description: Add one local MP4 to your Library. The original file stays unchanged.
importVideo.cancelFailed: Could not cancel yet. Try again, or wait for the import to finish.
importVideo.failedBody: The import could not finish. Check that the file is readable and that there is enough disk space, then try again.
importVideo.body: H.264 video with AAC audio. Click capture is unavailable for imported videos; guides can use narration.

showhowBrief.makeTitle: Make a brief for your agent
showhowBrief.makeBody: Turn this recording into a requested change, observed behaviour and timestamped evidence.
showhowBrief.local: Your recording stays on this Mac. AI is used only when you make the brief.
showhowBrief.keepUsing: You can keep using Showhow while this runs
showhowBrief.safeMaking: Your recording is safe. The brief appears here when it is ready.
showhowBrief.errorChanged: Recording changed. Check what's sent again
showhowBrief.errorNoInput: No clicks or speech to work from
showhowBrief.noInputTitle: Nothing to turn into a brief
showhowBrief.safeFailed: Your recording is safe. Try again or change the AI provider.
showhowBrief.copyNote: Copy includes the brief and the local bundle path. Give your agent access to that folder.
showhowBrief.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Your brief is saved; try again.
showhowBrief.reviewBody: Sent to OpenRouter only when you continue. The brief is saved in this recording's folder.
showhowBrief.always: Send briefs without asking next time

showhowPdf.title: Export PDF
showhowPdf.chooseFailed: Couldn't open the save panel. Try again.
showhowPdf.failed: Couldn't export the PDF. Your recording is unchanged. Try again.
showhowPdf.revealFailed: Couldn't show the PDF in Finder.

showhowSettings.title: Settings
showhowSettings.connectionsIntro: Recording, editing and step-finding run on this Mac. Optional AI connections are used for guides and briefs, and for automatic titles when enabled. Editor AI edits keep their own provider settings.
showhowSettings.chatgptBody: Signing in with your ChatGPT plan is coming later. Use an OpenRouter key for now.
showhowSettings.openrouterBody: Use your own OpenRouter key for guides and briefs.
showhowSettings.statusError: Couldn't check AI connections. Try reopening Settings.
showhowSettings.recordingIntro: Where recordings are saved and how a recording starts.
showhowSettings.folderNote: Showhow saves every recording here. Change this folder for future recordings.
showhowSettings.hideIconsNote: Hides desktop icons in display recordings.
showhowSettings.saveError: Couldn't save. Your previous setting is kept.
showhowSettings.transcriptionIntro: Speech to text runs on this Mac and works offline.
showhowSettings.whisperBody: Transcribes your narration for guides and briefs. Ships inside Showhow. Editor captions use their own model.
showhowSettings.termsNote: Custom names and terms are coming later.
showhowSettings.agentsIntro: How Showhow hands a brief to your coding agent.
showhowSettings.mcpNote: Let agents read your library directly. Coming later.
showhowSettings.appearanceIntro: Showhow follows your Mac unless you pick one.
showhowSettings.folderChooseError: Couldn't choose a recordings folder. Try again.
showhowSettings.folderSameError: That is already your recordings folder.
showhowSettings.folderNestedError: Choose a folder outside your current recordings folder.
showhowSettings.folderPickerDescription: Showhow will save new recordings to {{folder}}. Move the {{count}} recording{{plural}} in {{currentFolder}} there too? If you keep them where they are, they won’t show in your Library.
showhowSettings.folderChangeError: Couldn't save the recordings folder. No recordings were moved.
showhowSettings.folderMoveFailed: Couldn't finish moving {{name}}. The move stopped.
showhowSettings.folderRecovery: A verified copy is available at {{folder}}.
showhowSettings.nameRecordingsWithAiNote: When enabled, completed transcripts and click labels go to OpenRouter when a key is connected. User titles and imported video names stay unchanged.
showhowSettings.nameRecordingsWithAiError: Could not save this preference. The previous setting is kept.

showhowTrash.title: Move to Trash?
showhowTrash.body: “{{title}}” and everything in its folder — video, guide, brief and screenshots — goes to the macOS Trash. You can put it back from there.
showhowTrash.restoreError: Couldn't restore — it's still in your Trash
showhowTrash.moveError: Couldn't move to Trash. The recording is still in your Library.
